opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. University development office coordinates applications.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and major equipment to enable high-quality research and improve research infrastructure. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Maximum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment); £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results, a 'Good' or above inspection outcome, and demonstrable excellence.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment and technical equipment to improve teaching of GCSE/A-Level subjects requiring specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). One-stage process. 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation and education spaces at historic sites of national significance. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working with disability, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment helping people with disabilities live more independently, particularly training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for mental health charities, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities providing care and services for older people, with at least a 'Good' CQC rating where applicable. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a capital funding shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and families. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities operating fully accredited libraries/archives holding nationally significant collections, open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces to improve access to nationally significant collections. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities operating accredited museums/galleries holding nationally significant collections, open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities focused on professional performance, able to demonstrate significance of education work within the sector.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve performing arts training and education facilities, generally building or refurbishing facilities and occasionally purchasing specialist equipment. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent), local authorities or universities displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Grants for refurbishing or creating galleries and education/learning spaces to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities running special schools/colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment supporting pupils at secondary level to develop skills for employment or independent living. Two-stage process, two rounds per year.
